d:
The rustic old world charm of a romantic folk melody marries new-age synth in this love track Ei Suzhali. Vijaynarain collaborates with Santhosh Narayanan yet again for this romantic number for which Vivek has penned the lyrics.
Song Name - Ei Suzhali
Movie - Kodi
Singer - Vijaynarain
Music - Santhosh Narayanan
Lyrics - Vivek
Slide Guitars - Pradeep Kumar
Dholak - Ganapathi, Kiran
